An '''R2 unit''' was used by [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] during a [[Battle of Gall|battle]] over [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. It was programmed by the traitorous [[Viera Cheran]], [[Chief Technician]] for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], to take over control of Janson's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]] and shoot down [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. It failed, as Skywalker was able to destroy the droid and disable Janson's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]].
